digest.component_or_area: jira_datacenter adapter, outbound differ, comment/description synchronization
propositions: DC backend has no convergence test suites for comment or description truncation, while Cloud has two such incident-hardened suites that verify two-pass idempotence
DC's sanitize_comment binds both comment and description to WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767) and uses the description fitter fit_outbound, creating coupling risk and unclear provenance

The comment limit 32767 is the documented default of jira.text.field.character.limit (which covers Comments, Description, and Text custom fields) per JRASERVER-28519, not an assumption—this provenance must be cited at the binding site

Tests driven through compute_outbound_mutations or _diff_comments without explicit backend injection fall back to Cloud's sanitizer/mappers via select_backend(load_config()), silently testing Cloud while claiming to test DC

DC comment and description convergence must be proven by separate test files using explicit DC backend injection and by identity/recording proofs (not value-only assertions), because DC and Cloud truncate at identical byte boundaries and append identical suffixes
